name: The Architect's Loop
tagline: The Architect’s Loop is a privacy-first toolkit of 15 free browser utilities for founders, creators, and small website owners
description: The Architect’s Loop is a privacy-first toolkit of 15 free browser utilities for founders, creators, and small website owners. Audit website visibility, generate meta tags, estimate ad revenue, convert Markdown, clean CSV files, and prepare launch-ready assets — all in your browser, with no accounts, no tracking, no server uploads, and no AI costs.
